description: This file defines a PathEvaluator class that implements the TypeEvaluator interface for interpolating between PathPoint objects in Android animations. It provides the evaluate method to compute intermediate PathPoint values given a start point, an end point, and a fraction t, supporting curve and line operations.

classes.name: PathEvaluator
classes.description: A class that implements the TypeEvaluator interface for PathPoint objects, evaluating intermediate PathPoints for animations.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Interpolates between startValue and endValue PathPoints based on fraction t, supporting curve and line operations.
